name: Compile Manifest
description: Compiles all specifications into a final assembly manifest for rendering.

inputs.name: voiceover_assignments
inputs.description: State input: voiceover_assignments - step 3.01's voiceover-sourced speech blocks. Each becomes an A1 clip playing the catalogued audio file's span over its timeline range, while B-roll covers its picture. Absent on runs whose assign_aroll predates it; empty on runs with no voiceover.

inputs.name: color_grade_spec
inputs.description: State input: color_grade_spec, from step 5.01. OPTIONAL: an absent grade compiles to `color_grade: {}`, the renderer applies no CDL and no house-look Fusion values, and the picture ships ungraded. That is series_look.NEUTRAL_CDL's case: nothing drawn, not a look chosen.

inputs.name: enhancement_spec
inputs.description: State input: enhancement_spec, from step 4.03. OPTIONAL: an absent VFX plan compiles to `vfx: []` and no per-clip Fusion comp is written for an effect nobody planned. The absence of decoration is not a choice of decoration (AGENTS.md section 10.5).

inputs.name: behind_subject_overlays
inputs.description: State input: behind_subject_overlays from step 4.06 - full-canvas title segments planned with layer behind_subject. OPTIONAL: each is precomposited under the subject's 1.06 matte into a qtrle overlay placed on a motion-graphics row (library/tools/behind_subject.py); a request with no usable matte refuses the compile by name.

inputs.name: timed_text_overlay
inputs.description: State input: timed_text_overlay from step 4.06 - the rendered segments for the brand template's declared text moments, placed on V6. See library/tools/timed_text_overlay.py.

inputs.name: object_segmentation
inputs.description: State input: object_segmentation from step 1.06 - per-clip results plus the matte_trigger record naming which clips the plans wanted mattes for. OPTIONAL: the masks themselves travel as 1_06_object_segmentation/<clip_id>_segmentation.json files; this key is the provenance the compile grounds against.

inputs.name: sfx_spec
inputs.description: State input: sfx_spec, from step 4.04. OPTIONAL: an absent sound plan compiles to an empty A3, and no sound is substituted - `sfx_type` is still a decision step 4.04 makes, and a planned entry that names none still fails the step.

inputs.name: temporal_index
inputs.description: State input: temporal_index. Read for the per-clip face-centre track that drives subject-aware framing (P1.2); optional, and a run without it frames centred.

inputs.name: transition_spec
inputs.description: State input: transition_spec, from step 4.02. OPTIONAL: a cut the plan did not decorate is a hard cut (AGENTS.md section 5), so an absent transition plan compiles to `transitions: []` and the edit cuts. Measured in tests/test_compile_manifest_without_the_decoration.py.
